families.title: Status
families.description: Inspect CLI provenance, authentication, project state, Git state, and an optional resolved target.

families.title: Target resolution
families.description: Turn supported URLs and DA paths into explicit organization, repository, branch, environment, and route identity.

families.title: Authentication
families.description: Establish, inspect, verify, and deliberately remove Adobe IMS credential state without leaking the token.

families.title: Configuration
families.description: Manage project context and user preferences while keeping high-risk target authority explicit.

families.title: Operational workspace
families.description: Resolve and govern external mutable state for content, jobs, pipelines, reports, and migrations.

families.title: Local runtime
families.description: Enter the deterministic inspection server or the official AEM local runtime through one explicit front door.

families.title: DA content
families.description: Read and change DA-authored source directly or through the managed clone–diff–commit–push workflow.

families.title: Block contracts
families.description: Inspect the authored block inventory and the content shape a block is expected to receive.

families.title: Route ownership
families.description: Classify, normalize, audit, and deliberately clean paths whose content/code ownership must be explicit.

families.title: Site model and health
families.description: Discover, model, diagnose, reconcile, register, and create EDS sites through bounded contracts.

families.title: Preview delivery
families.description: Activate and inspect candidate delivery on the preview boundary without implying live publication.

families.title: Live publication
families.description: Promote reviewed preview output to live delivery or explicitly remove a live path.

families.title: Deployment coordination
families.description: Coordinate supported delivery activation while preserving preview and live as separate boundaries.

families.title: Code bus
families.description: Inspect, verify, synchronize, purge, and observe Git-backed code delivery state.

families.title: Audits
families.description: Produce structured evidence about semantics, content gaps, blocks, media, links, and code contracts.

families.title: Design assurance
families.description: Detect design systems and turn visual rules and tokens into repeatable checks.

families.title: Content indexes
families.description: Inspect and operate Configuration Service index definitions and generated query data.

families.title: Sitemaps
families.description: Rebuild and verify sitemap state against explicit route expectations.

families.title: Durable jobs
families.description: Persist path-level preview or publish work so attempts, retries, cancellation, and outcomes survive interruption.

families.title: Pipelines
families.description: Compose validated command graphs with dependencies, approvals, retries, reconciliation, and durable run state.

families.title: Migration
families.description: Validate and execute bounded import and migration work with explicit source and route contracts.

families.title: Commerce
families.description: Inspect and plan the bounded commerce surface while keeping catalog, generated-artifact, and routing authorities separate.

families.title: Agent skills
families.description: Discover and manage skill sources while retaining provenance and install intent.

families.title: Stardust
families.description: Run experimental design, extraction, prototype, migration, reset, and update workflows with explicit stability limits.

commands.description: Obtain and cache a DA Bearer token via da-auth-helper
commands.help:
Usage: da auth login [options]

Obtain and cache a DA Bearer token via da-auth-helper

Options:
  --refresh   Bypass the da-cli cache and verify whether helper-provided expiry
              advances
  --host      Emit the token-free host lifecycle as NDJSON; requires --format
              json

The interactive helper wait is bounded to about five minutes. If automatic browser
opening fails, an allowlisted Adobe IMS authorization URL is surfaced on stderr.
Concurrent helpers that collide on callback port 9898 return a distinct failure.

commands.description: Manage DA CLI configuration
commands.help:
Usage: da config [options] [command]

Manage DA CLI configuration

Options:
  --global                     Operate on ~/.da/config.json
  --unset <key>                Remove one key; deletes an empty config file
  --unpin-target               Remove org, repo, branch, and target binding
                               without changing auth or workspace state
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]               Interactive setup for project target
                               configuration or user-global non-target
                               preferences
  get <key>                    Print a single resolved config value
  set [options] <key> <value>  Set an allowed project/global config key
  show [options]               Print resolved config, source annotations, and
                               target/config diagnostics

Target cleanup:
  da config --unset branch
  da config --unpin-target
  da config --global --unpin-target
  da --dry-run --format json config --global --unpin-target

commands.description: Upload a document or binary asset — dry-run by default, shows diff for text; pass --commit to write
commands.help:
Usage: da content put [options] <path> <file>

Upload a document or binary asset — dry-run by default, shows diff for text;
pass --commit to write

Options:
  --draft                            Upload under /drafts to keep experimental
                                     content off canonical routes
  --draft-prefix <path>              Draft content prefix used with --draft
                                     (default: "/drafts")
  --allow-outside-worktree           Opt in to upload a path outside the project
                                     cwd — you own the risk
  --wrap                             Wrap body-only HTML in the DA
                                     <body><header><main><footer> structure
                                     before upload
  --rewrite-media-urls               Rewrite host-less /media img/srcset to
                                     https://content.da.live/{org}/{repo}/…
                                     (f010)
  --strict-media-urls                Fail the put when host-less /media image
                                     URLs are present (f010)
  --strict-sections                  Fail when block classes are direct <main>
                                     children
  --no-strict-sections               Allow direct-<main> block classes even on
                                     DA-backed repos
  --allow-top-level-blocks           Alias for --no-strict-sections
  --allow-unverified-source          Allow explicit-target writes when effective
                                     source probing fails
  --expected-review-digest <digest>  Require the freshly recomputed
                                     effective-payload review to match this
                                     expected sha256 digest
  --yes                              Accepted for consistency with bulk write
                                     commands; single-file puts do not require
                                     confirmation
  -h, --help                         display help for command

                             <body><header><main><footer> structure before
                             upload
  --rewrite-media-urls       Rewrite host-less /media img/srcset to
                             content.da.live (f010)
  --strict-media-urls        Fail put-tree when any HTML has host-less /media
                             image URLs (f010)
  --strict-sections          Fail when any HTML file has block classes as direct
                             <main> children
  --no-strict-sections       Allow direct-<main> block classes even on DA-backed
                             repos
  --allow-top-level-blocks   Alias for --no-strict-sections
  --allow-unverified-source  Allow explicit-target writes when effective source
                             probing fails
  --yes                      Confirm committed bulk upload after reviewing the
                             preflight

commands.description: Trigger EDS preview pipeline — updates *.aem.page only; run `da publish` to promote to *.aem.live
commands.help:
Usage: da preview [options] [command] [path]

Trigger EDS preview pipeline — updates *.aem.page only; run `da publish` to
promote to *.aem.live

Arguments:
  path                         Shortcut for `preview page <path>`

Options:
  --branch <branch>            Git branch (overrides config.branch, default:
                               main)
  --draft                      Preview the path under /drafts to keep
                               experimental content off canonical routes
  --draft-prefix <path>        Draft content prefix used with --draft (default:
                               "/drafts")
  --yes                        Confirm committed preview after reviewing the
                               preflight
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Commands:
  page [options] <path>        Preview a single page — flushes DA cache then
                               triggers Helix pipeline (*.aem.page only; use
                               publish to go live)
  pages [options] <source...>  Batch preview — accepts direct paths, a path
                               file, or a /prefix/ for all pages (*.aem.page
                               only; use publish to go live)
  tree [options] [prefix]      Preview every HTML source document under a DA
                               prefix, including nav/footer if present
  status [options] <path>      Check Helix preview pipeline status for a path
  explain [options] <path>     Compare DA source with preview .plain.html;
                               surface removed block classes and
                               metadata-channel conflicts

Agent notes:
  preview mutates the preview tier only (*.aem.page). It never promotes to live; use da publish for *.aem.live.
  Committed preview writes need root --commit. Bulk previews also require --yes after the preflight.
  For large trees, prefer preview tree --job --run, then da job watch, then da job promote when preview succeeds.

Examples:
  da --commit preview page /index.html
  da --commit preview page /products/foo.html --branch feature-foo --draft --yes
  da preview status /index.html --format json
  da preview explain /index.html --format json
  da --commit preview tree / --job --run --yes

commands.help:
Usage: da site freshness [options] [prefix]

Report DA source, preview, and live freshness for source documents under a
prefix

Options:
  --branch <branch>      Git branch (overrides config.branch, default: main)
  --include-shared       Include nav/footer under the established shared source
                         root
  --shared-root <path>   Required for nested sites; resolve shared nav/footer
                         under this source root
  --concurrency <n>      Max parallel preview/live status probes (default: "8")
  --verdict <verdicts>   Only print comma-separated verdicts, for example
                         live-stale,preview-only
  --fail-on <verdicts>   Exit nonzero when any comma-separated verdict is
                         present
  --boundary <boundary>  Terminal promotion boundary for this session: live
                         (default) or preview (default: "live")
  -h, --help             display help for command

Agent notes:
  This command is read-only. It compares DA source timestamps with preview and live timestamps.
  Use --include-shared to catch stale shared documents such as nav and footer.
  Use --verdict to focus output, and --fail-on to turn freshness drift into a release gate.
  Rows include verdict and next[] so agents can decide whether to preview, publish, or inspect status.
  Use --boundary preview to declare live promotion out of scope for this session: rows whose
  preview already matches source ('preview-only', 'live-stale') report no publish suggestion in
  next[] and count as fresh in the printed summary. Default --boundary live is unchanged from prior
  releases. --boundary never changes --fail-on exit-code behavior; it only affects next[] and the
  human summary presentation.

Examples:
  da site freshness / --include-shared --format json
  da site freshness /site --include-shared --shared-root /site --format json
  da site freshness / --verdict live-stale,preview-only
  da site freshness / --include-shared --fail-on preview-stale,live-stale,preview-only
  da site freshness / --boundary preview --format json
  da site freshness /news --format table
  da site freshness /nav --format json

commands.description: Run the local inspection server or orchestrate the official AEM CLI runtime
commands.help:
Usage: da up [options]

Run the local inspection server or orchestrate the official AEM CLI runtime

Options:
  --mode <mode>                Server mode: inspect (deterministic source/proxy)
                               | runtime (official aem up) (default: "inspect")
  -p, --port <port>            Port to listen on (0 requests an ephemeral port)
                               (default: 3000)
  --host <host>                Host to bind (default: "127.0.0.1")
  --root <dir>                 Code repository root to serve (default: ".")
  --content <dir>              inspect: local DA content workspace directory
                               (defaults to the resolved workspace)
  --fallback <mode>            inspect: fallback for missing local files:
                               preview | live | none (default: "preview")
  --branch <branch>            EDS branch for the content origin (content
                               selection only, never local code)
  --no-content                 inspect: disable resolved local content-workspace
                               lookup
  --aem-cli <path>             runtime: explicit official AEM CLI executable or
                               index.js entry
  --url <origin>               runtime: explicit content origin forwarded to the
                               official runtime
  --open [path]                runtime: open a browser at path after readiness
                               (default: do not open)
  --no-livereload              runtime: disable live reload in the official
                               runtime
  --forward-browser-logs       runtime: forward browser console logs to the
                               terminal (requires livereload)
  --html-folder <dir>          runtime: serve local HTML files from this folder
                               through the official runtime
  --html-mount <path>          runtime: URL path where --html-folder files are
                               served
  --prefer-plain-html          runtime: prefer <stem>.plain.html over
                               <stem>.html in --html-folder
  --stop-other                 runtime: ask another AEM dev server on the port
                               to exit first (official default; opt-in here)
  --startup-timeout <seconds>  runtime: seconds to wait for official readiness
                               (default: 60)
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Agent notes:
  Modes are explicit and never degrade into each other.
  inspect (default): deterministic local source/proxy inspection. Resolution order is
    local code, then resolved local DA source, then preview/live fallback unless disabled.
    Responses expose provenance: x-da-source is local, content, or fallback; fallback
    responses also include x-da-fallback-url. Local DA HTML is source material, not an
    EDS-decorated page.
  runtime: da-cli discovers a locally installed official @adobe/aem-cli
    (--aem-cli path, then <root>/node_modules, then PATH), verifies its version, and
    orchestrates the complete EDS runtime: decoration, block loading, shared nav/footer,
    routing, 404s, live reload, and query strings. da-cli never reimplements decoration
    and never installs the official CLI. --branch selects the content origin only;
    local code provenance (git ref, SHA, dirty state) is reported separately.
  Both modes print one readiness object on stdout (--format json for machine use);
  runtime child logs stream to stderr so stdout stays parseable.

Examples:
  da up
  da up --fallback preview --port 3000
  da up --mode runtime
  da up --mode runtime --url https://main--example--org.aem.page --forward-browser-logs
